'''Arca Jeth University''' was a university on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] that was renamed in honor of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] after his death. A young [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] named [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]] once attended this university.<ref name="KOTOR48" />
